eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, the earliest GP appointment please.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Lucia Fernandez Ortega, born 30th of June 92.
Ficha encontrada: Lucía F. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)

Sin huecos en medicina general · frenados por regla: Dr. Pablo Requena (el cupo del seguro está agotado), Dra. Elena Ortiz (el cupo del seguro está agotado) y Dr. Andrés Sáez (el cupo del seguro está agotado)
Thank you, Lucía, I have your record here. Your Caser plan doesn't cover any more visits this year. Do you have any other insurance I could use?
Tema ajeno a la clínica (0,94): declina sin leer datos de nadie
I'm sorry, I can't help with that. I can only help with appointments, and I can't share anything about other patients or give medical advice. Is there anything else I can help with?
Sin gestión · lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
